# 2 Baruch Chapter 29 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** He answered me: As for what will happen at that time — everyone alive on the earth will rejoice.

**2** At that time, the heavenly storehouse of manna will open and manna will come down again from above. The people will eat it during those years, because they have reached the culmination of all the ages.

**3** At that time, the storehouses of dew will be unlocked — dew will fall from above and well up from below — and the people will once again eat the fruit of the earth.

**4** At that time, Behemoth will emerge from his hiding place and Leviathan will rise from the sea — those two enormous monsters that I created on the fifth day of creation and have kept in reserve until now. They will become food for everyone who survives.

**5** The earth will produce fruit a ten-thousandfold. A single vine will have a thousand branches; each branch will have a thousand clusters; each cluster will have a thousand grapes; and each grape will yield a whole cor of wine.

**6** The hungry will feast and rejoice; and every day they will see extraordinary wonders.

**7** Every morning, winds will carry to them the scent of sweet-smelling fruits; and every evening, clouds of healing dew will settle down upon them.

**8** At that time, the heavenly storehouse of manna will open once more and come down from above, and the people will eat it in those years, for they will have reached the very end of the ages.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering of the messianic paradise. The Behemoth/Leviathan banquet (v.4) is one of the most vivid eschatological images in Second Temple literature. The vineyard hyperbole (v.5) is deliberately extravagant — a hundred-thousandfold amplification of ordinary agriculture.*
